title: Image proofing
idea: Image proofing: Image canvas and color delivery settings expose crop constraints
audience: People who need to proof image within a desktop surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic craft layout through its proof image priority and explicit commitment contract: Display profile assumptions and export limitations
navigation: Image proofing keeps the current proof image context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Image canvas and color delivery settings expose crop constraints
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to proof image; output fidelity matters
composition.priority: Display profile assumptions and export limitations

imagery.role: Support the actual proof image context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep zoom and fit options with non-gesture alternatives
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the image proofing structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no proof image content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Display profile assumptions and export limitations
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized proof image content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Display profile assumptions and export limitations
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active proof image context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
